import sys

s = sys.stdin.read().strip()
max_count = 0
result = ""

for i in range(len(s)):
    for j in range(i + 1, len(s) + 1):
        sub = s[i:j]
        count = s.count(sub)
        if count > max_count or (count == max_count and (len(sub) > len(result) or (len(sub) == len(result) and sub > result))):
            max_count = count
            result = sub

print(result)
